headline_marked: Bodies of [[couple and newborn recovered from locked flat]] in Ashulia
headline: Bodies of couple and newborn recovered from locked flat in Ashulia
summary: Police found the decomposed remains of a man, his pregnant wife, and a five-month-old fetus inside a locked room after neighbors reported a foul smell.
details: Police recovered the decomposed bodies of a man, his pregnant wife, and a five-month-old fetus from a locked flat in the Jamgora area of Ashulia, Savar.
The deceased have been identified as Alamgir Hossain and Nazma Begum, who had rented the room as a couple.
Neighbors alerted the police after noticing a foul smell emanating from the flat, noting that the doors and windows were usually kept closed.
Upon breaking the lock and entering the room, police first discovered the body of the husband, with the bodies of Nazma Begum and the fetus lying beside him.
A forensic team from the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) has collected evidence from the scene.
Police have stated that they initially suspect the deaths may be the result of a murder.
caption:
A foul smell led neighbors to alert police, who discovered the decomposed bodies of a couple and their unborn child in a locked room.

Police recovered the decomposed bodies of a man, his pregnant wife, and a five-month-old fetus from a locked flat in the Jamgora area of Ashulia, Savar.

The deceased have been identified as Alamgir Hossain and Nazma Begum, who had rented the room as a couple.

Neighbors alerted the police after noticing a foul smell emanating from the flat, noting that the doors and windows were usually kept closed.

Upon breaking the lock and entering the room, police first discovered the body of the husband, with the bodies of Nazma Begum and the fetus lying beside him.

A forensic team from the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) has collected evidence from the scene.

Police have stated that they initially suspect the deaths may be the result of a murder.

Source: Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star

headline_marked: 4 US missiles hit [[Iranian oil tanker near Kharg Island]]
headline: 4 US missiles hit Iranian oil tanker near Kharg Island
summary: Reports indicate the vessel is being emptied following the attack. Kharg Island is a critical hub, handling nearly 90% of Iran's oil exports.
details: Qatar-based Al Jazeera and Iranian media outlets report that four US missiles struck an Iranian oil tanker near Kharg Island.
Following the attack, efforts are reportedly underway to empty the tanker's cargo.
There have been no immediate reports of casualties or the specific extent of the damage caused by the missiles.
Kharg Island is a vital strategic asset for Iran, as approximately 90% of the country's total oil exports are processed and shipped from this location.
Reports of explosions were also heard around Kharg Island on Saturday, though the Fars News Agency stated the source of these blasts could not be immediately confirmed.
Tensions between the US and Iran have escalated around the island recently, with a similar report of a US missile hitting an empty tanker at the export terminal in July.
While Iranian media have made these claims, the United States has not yet issued an official confirmation or statement regarding the incident.
caption:
Four US missiles reportedly struck an Iranian oil tanker near a critical export hub. No casualties have been reported so far.

Qatar-based Al Jazeera and Iranian media outlets report that four US missiles struck an Iranian oil tanker near Kharg Island.

Following the attack, efforts are reportedly underway to empty the tanker's cargo.

There have been no immediate reports of casualties or the specific extent of the damage caused by the missiles.

Kharg Island is a vital strategic asset for Iran, as approximately 90% of the country's total oil exports are processed and shipped from this location.

Reports of explosions were also heard around Kharg Island on Saturday, though the Fars News Agency stated the source of these blasts could not be immediately confirmed.

Tensions between the US and Iran have escalated around the island recently, with a similar report of a US missile hitting an empty tanker at the export terminal in July.

While Iranian media have made these claims, the United States has not yet issued an official confirmation or statement regarding the incident.
